purpose: Make critical and repeated CRM writes explicit, reviewable and evidenced.

requestPreview.description: Validates and prepares impact without executing the mutation.

confirm.description: Requests the exact backend operation after human review.

cancel.description: Discards or closes the current draft/preview.

openReceiptTarget.description: Navigates to the record evidenced by the receipt.

accessibility.keyboard: All decisions are native buttons in deterministic order.
accessibility.focus: Failure preserves review context; receipt action follows evidence.
accessibility.screenReader: Before/after, consequence, outcome and evidence are textual.

invariants: Draft never calls the mutation operation.
Confirm uses CSRF plus backend-required version and idempotency metadata from the API layer.
A batch retry always starts a new preview and includes only retryable items.
Queued provider work is not described as delivered without provider evidence.
